text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Reconsidering the Grand Live." To achieve 
that, they first decided to re-examine the 
concept from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through their conversation, they realized 
that a live performance isn't just a 
one-way street for showing gratitude. A 
live stage belongs not only to the 
Umamusume, but to the fans as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello wished to see her senior's 
live. Yes, as a fan, she was the one who 
needed the Grand Live stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that case, what does the "Grand Live" 
mean to the fans? They decided to dig 
deeper into that aspect.
